title: Rank and border rank of three small tripartitioning tensors
statement: Let T_{a,b,c} = Σ x_A y_B z_C over all ordered partitions (A, B, C) of [a+b+c] with |A| = a, |B| = b, |C| = c. (1) Explicit identities over ℤ with coefficients in {−1, 0, 1} (data/T112_rank7.json, T113_rank11.json, T122_rank14.json, SHA-256 pinned) give 4·T_{1,1,2}, 4·T_{1,1,3} and 4·T_{1,2,2} as sums of 7, 11 and 14 rank-one tensors, so over every field of characteristic ≠ 2 their ranks are at most 7, 11 and 14. (2) Their border ranks are at least 7 and 13 for T_{1,1,2} and T_{1,2,2} (Koszul–Young flattenings with p = 2, ranks of explicit 40 × 40 and 100 × 100 integer matrices computed modulo every prime q ≤ 31), over ℂ and over every field of characteristic 0 or of prime characteristic q ≤ 31; and at least 10 for T_{1,1,3} over every field (flattening). (3) Hence R(T_{1,1,2}) = border rank(T_{1,1,2}) = 7 over ℂ and over every field of characteristic 0 or 3 ≤ q ≤ 31; 10 ≤ border rank ≤ R(T_{1,1,3}) ≤ 11 in characteristic ≠ 2; 13 ≤ border rank ≤ R(T_{1,2,2}) ≤ 14 over ℂ and in characteristic 0 or 3 ≤ q ≤ 31.
